details.welcome: We are so excited to spend the day with you and cannot wait to have all of our favorite people together to celebrate Baby Hickam.
details.refreshments: Food and non-alcoholic drinks will be provided for everyone to enjoy.
details.gifts: Gifts from our registry are welcome, but please do not feel obligated. Celebrating with you is what matters most to us.
details.books: Please bring a favorite children’s book in place of a card. You can write a little note inside for Baby Hickam to enjoy for years to come.
details.diaperRaffle: Bring a pack of diapers to be entered into our diaper raffle.
